paragraphs: Rabbi Natan, son of Rabbi Berechyah.

Mentioned in Yalkut, Kohelet, chapter 5, on the verse beginning “Ve-yitron”: Rabbi Yishmael bar Tanchuma and Rabbi Natan, son of Rabbi Berechyah, in the name of Rabbi Yirmiyah. Kohelet Rabbah there has a different version.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The different version in Kohelet Rabbah is not specified by the notice. No additional verse number or variant content is supplied.
Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 971:26 gives the attribution Hyman cites. The parallel exposition in the consulted Kohelet Rabbah 5:8 names Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yose and Rabbi Chanin.
